title: Joseph Choi — portfolio with personality
note: An interesting reference for portfolios with personality that are NOT the classic minimalist designer style. Choi split his marketing and product sides into orange and blue characters who host the whole site. Her takeaway: personality can be the portfolio's organising structure, paralleling her own split practice — designer who ships code versus artist/DJ. LinkedIn post: https://lnkd.in/p/enAPbDWv
